articles.title: Oshawa funeral home fire was arson, police say

articles.title: Cliff Booth’s next act: Quentin Tarantino’s new novel arrives as David Fincher directs the sequel
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Quentin Tarantino has stepped back from directing in recent years, but he continues to build upon his career as an author. The upcoming spinoff from his “Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood” will be accompanied by Tarantino's novelization of the new film.
